name: Security and Privacy Controls for Information Systems and Organizations
issuing_organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
notes: The comprehensive catalog of security and privacy controls for federal information systems.

derives_from.note: FISMA directs NIST to develop security guidelines for federal systems.
FIPS 200 mandates the use of 800-53 controls to meet minimum security requirements.

references.note: Uses FIPS 199 categorization to select control baselines.
